title: Primary controls and chosen accents keep readable labels, hover states, accent words and focus strokes
steps: Run the primary contrast suite and render the real shared Button with generated add-site CSS and the brand theme layer in Chromium, for the default and eight chosen colours, in both modes, at rest and hovered.
expect: All 72 primary/destructive rendered states read at least 4.5:1. Derived accent words read at least 4.5:1 on their mode background, and focus strokes at least 3:1. The chosen brand mark is retained.
evidence: Issue #228 re-test: theme.mjs primaryTokens wrote --primary #bf5b3d inline on <body>, 4.21:1
fence: theme.mjs primaryTokens, shared Button variants and their generated CSS
